compute_mape_score: compute the mean absolute percentage error between predictions and references using the Mape metric
load_mape_metric: load the Mape metric from the HuggingFace evaluate library for regression evaluation
get_mape_feature_types: get the dataset feature types for the Mape metric based on the config name
get_mape_metric_info: retrieve the Mape metric info including description, citation, and reference URLs
compute_multilist_mape: compute MAPE on multi-dimensional predictions and references using the multilist config
